title: WV GSD Capitol Complex Elevator Modernizations
services: Elevator Evaluation · Mechanical · Electrical · Fire Protection · Construction Management
overview: MEI and Richard Kennedy & Associates evaluated 31 elevator systems across the State Capitol Complex and designed modernizations in a three-phase, roughly $20M program — rebuilding machine rooms and bringing systems into code compliance with as few variances as possible. Phase I covered seven elevators at the Capitol and two each at Buildings 7 and 25, with the passenger cars, doors, and landings guided by the State Historic Preservation Office.
